# Search, query language and saved filters

All HTTP paths below are prefixed with `/api/v1`. Every route requires authentication. Cookie mutations include `X-Crew-Request: 1`. Read operations require `insight:read` token scope plus current organization membership and project access. Saved-filter mutations require `insight:write` and the appropriate current organization role. A token scope never grants a project or team membership. Lists accept `limit` from 1 to 200 and opaque `cursor`.

## Query language

`GET /search?orgId=ORG&q=QUERY&projectId=OPTIONAL` searches one organization's accessible issues. Empty `q` includes all accessible issues. Adjacent expressions mean AND. The precedence order is NOT, AND, OR; parentheses override it. Boolean keywords are case-insensitive. Names, IDs and free text normalize Unicode with NFKC and compare case-insensitively.

Examples:

```text
status:active AND assignee:@me
project:APP AND (label:bug OR priority>=3)
"search index" AND NOT status:done
created>2026-01-01 AND updated<2027-01-01
status:"In Progress" AND label:"Ship today"
```

Bare free-text terms match token prefixes in issue key, title, description, label names and comment bodies. Quoted terms match contiguous phrases in an individual field. A term containing several token pieces requires all of them within that field. Double and single quotes support escaped quote, backslash, newline, carriage return and tab. Unknown escapes and unclosed quotes fail with a positioned error. Quote full UTC timestamps because their colons otherwise delimit filters.

Fields:

| Field | Values | Operators |
| --- | --- | --- |
| status | exact status ID, status name or category todo/active/done | `:`, `=`, `!=` |
| assignee | exact ID, name, email, `@me`, `unassigned` or `none` | `:`, `=`, `!=` |
| label | exact label ID or name | `:`, `=`, `!=` |
| project | exact project ID or key within this organization | `:`, `=`, `!=` |
| priority | integer 0 through 4 | `:`, `=`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=` |
| created, updated | real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date or quoted UTC ISO timestamp | `:`, `=`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=` |

Date-only values mean midnight UTC. An equality compares that exact instant. There is a 4000-character query limit and a 64-level grouping/NOT nesting limit. Query parse errors return HTTP 422 `{error:{code:'VALIDATION',message,details:{query,offset,end,line,column}}}`. `offset` and `end` are zero-based UTF-16 offsets; line and column are one-based. Unknown fields, unsupported field operators, missing operands and impossible dates fail explicitly. A project reference outside current access returns 403 without identifying the project.

## Index, ranking and safe output

Migration 300 creates persisted `search_documents` and `search_terms`. Registration reconciles canonical issues and comments once, then subscribes synchronously to issue create/update/delete, comment create/edit/delete and label/project/workflow changes. It reuses `getIssue(ctx,id)` for canonical issue hydration. Foreign-key cascades remove deleted issues/projects. A document content hash avoids replacing unchanged token rows. The candidate planner uses the token-prefix range index under organization/project predicates, intersects AND branches and unions OR branches. Negation and filter-only branches retain conservative candidates before exact canonical evaluation, preserving boolean semantics. Cleanup unsubscribes the index listener before database close. Restart reads persisted state and reconciles it with canonical work data.

Ranking adds weighted token-prefix frequency (key 14, title 8, label 5, description 2, discussion 1), a 1.25 multiplier for exact tokens, an exact title-phrase boost and a bounded recency score. Ties use updated time and stable issue ID. Authorization occurs before ranking, total counts, facets, highlights and pagination. Search suggestions use the same current access boundary. A removed project grant takes effect on the next request.

Search returns `{items,total,query,facets,nextCursor}`. Each item is the full public issue plus `score`, `matchFields` and `highlights`. Highlights contain title/description/comments arrays of `{text,match}` segments. They never contain trusted HTML. The web renders matching text with normal escaped Preact children inside a mark element; CLI JSON preserves the literal segments. Snippets are bounded excerpts around a first match. Grapheme normalization maps back to original UTF-16 ranges, retaining combining marks, normalization expansions and full surrogate pairs. Negative terms do not generate highlights. Facets count matched, accessible issues by status, assignee and priority. A cursor is bound to account, organization, optional project and query; changing those requires the first page again. Results reflect live state, so mutation between pages can move results.

`GET /search/catalog?orgId=ORG&projectId=OPTIONAL` returns the accessible project/status/label/assignee value catalog used by the structured builder. The same organization/project/scope checks run before returning any value.

`GET /search/suggestions?orgId=ORG&q=PREFIX&caret=OFFSET&projectId=OPTIONAL` returns `{items}` with each suggestion's label, description, replacement, kind, start/end edit range and complete query. It offers grammar fields/operators, current-user/unassigned assignees, 0–4 priorities, dates and accessible project/status/label/assignee values. At most 30 suggestions are returned. The shared parser and completion code run in server, web and CLI. Query suggestions never include private project names, statuses or labels.

## Saved filters

`GET /filters?orgId=ORG&visibility=personal|team|all&teamId=OPTIONAL&owned=true&q=OPTIONAL` lists filters visible to the current viewer with `{items,total,nextCursor}`. Name/description lookup is case-insensitive and accepts up to 100 characters. Ownership accepts true or false. All lookup and visibility filtering happens before pagination. A personal filter is visible only to its creator. A team filter requires current team membership in that same organization and visibility of every explicitly named project in its query. Removing team membership or a project grant immediately removes access to affected filters. Guessing an inaccessible filter ID returns 404 for read/run/edit/delete.

`GET /filters/options?orgId=ORG` returns current viewer's teams and accessible projects for forms. `GET /filters/:id` returns `{filter}`. Public filter fields are id, orgId, ownerId, teamId, visibility, name, description, query, revision, createdAt, updatedAt and canEdit.

`POST /filters` accepts `{orgId,name,query,description?,visibility?,teamId?}` and returns 201 `{filter}`. Visibility defaults to personal. Team visibility requires a team ID and current same-org team membership, including the creator. Personal filters must have no team ID. Queries validate before saving; names are 1–100 characters and description up to 1000. Duplicate creator/destination/name combinations return 409 case-insensitively.

`PATCH /filters/:id` accepts mutable fields plus optional `expectedRevision`. Only the creator may edit. Organization cannot change. An empty edit is rejected before incrementing revision. `expectedRevision` rejects a stale edit with 409; successful edits increment revision. `DELETE /filters/:id` is creator-only. Both recheck current team and organization access. Mutations emit savedFilter domain events with actor, organization, entity, before/after and time. No delivery credential is part of these records.

`GET /filters/:id/search?limit=N&cursor=CURSOR&projectId=OPTIONAL` runs the stored query with the executing viewer's current access and returns the search response plus `filter`. It cannot grant access by sharing a query. The index and filter tables live in the existing SQLite database under CREW_DATA_DIR; the existing backup guidance covers them.

## Web and CLI

Search offers organization/project selection, a query editor with positioned errors, keyboard-accessible field/value suggestions, grammar help, safe highlights, result links, facets and previous/next pages. Arrow keys navigate completions; Enter/Tab insert the selected value and Escape closes the list. Suggestions cancel obsolete requests. The applied-query snapshot remains explicit while the editor has unsent changes, so pagination retains the actual submitted query. Saved-filter links open the canonical `#/filters/:filterId` resource; Run links use `?run=1` and execute the currently saved query through `/filters/:id/search`, rather than a cached list query. Direct links show query, description, visibility, current team, revision, creation/update time and creator-relative ownership. No identity catalog or unrelated token scope is required for creator labels. The shared result presentation preserves safe highlights, issue links, totals and opaque previous/next cursor pages. A changed saved query can invalidate an earlier cursor; an error clears results and a separate Run starts again. A readable filter offers an explicit personal-copy form with name and visibility, rereads the source before opening, and creates a distinct filter through POST; source content remains unchanged. Duplicate destination names and current authority failures retain the form and show their errors. Organization/project selectors reuse the authorized searchable pager, resolve the selected ID independently from the current page and support later-page choices. The typed compound builder can load the editor query, add/remove/reorder conditions and nested AND/OR groups, negate conditions/groups, preview validated syntax and apply or submit it. Scoped catalogs offer current values; priority/date/operator validation reuses the exact shared grammar. Live status, pause/resume and explicit result refresh use the shared SSE client and clean up on route changes. Saved filters have create/edit forms, personal/team selection, current-team choices, description, revision-aware saves, ownership controls, name/description lookup, pagination, explicit refresh, clear errors and deliberate delete confirmation. A stale revision leaves the local draft intact. Inspection shows readable base/mine/latest fields; each overlapping field requires a deliberate mine/latest choice, while independent edits are preserved by the shared generic comparison used by work drafts. Applying choices changes the draft at the inspected revision; Save is separate and a second race still returns 409. Loading the latest version confirms before replacing a dirty draft. A deleted or inaccessible filter disables mutation while retaining the visible draft. Cancel, replacing an editor and organization changes confirm before discarding dirty edits; declining retains both draft and visible organization. Current save/inspection/edit/delete owners admit synchronous actions, pass AbortSignal and ignore success/error/finally callbacks after API, organization, filter or form replacement and unmount. An abandoned response does not undo a server-published mutation and is never replayed automatically. Scope changes hide prior records/cursors immediately. Active-page drafts are local; they are not durable browser-reload storage. Search URL `#/search?orgId=ORG&q=QUERY` preserves a shareable query. Browser acceptance uses input `data-testid=search-query`, the Search button and `search-result-ISSUEID` results.

Use `crew search --help` and `crew filter --help` for the complete interface. Examples:

```text
crew search --org ORG --query 'project:APP AND assignee:@me' --limit 25
crew search --org ORG --query-file query.txt --all
crew search suggest 'label:Sh' --org ORG
crew search check 'status:active OR priority>=3'
crew filter create --org ORG --name 'Urgent' --query 'priority>=3'
crew filter create --org ORG --name 'Team focus' --visibility team --team TEAM --query 'project:APP'
crew filter list --org ORG --visibility team --limit 25
crew filter show FILTER
crew filter edit FILTER --query 'priority>=4' --revision 1
crew filter run FILTER --all
crew filter delete FILTER --yes
```

CLI commands use the saved personal API token through the existing CrewClient. Search and filter run preserve result metadata and opaque pagination; `--all` traverses pages and rejects a repeated cursor. `search check` parses locally and reports the AST without server access. `--query-file` reads a local UTF-8 file and is mutually exclusive with `--query`. Deletion requires `--yes`; no retries or background processes are created.

Tests: shared/query.test.js covers precedence, each field/operator, escapes, parse positions and nesting; shared/suggestions.test.js covers grammar/value completions, quoting and caret edits; shared/query-builder.test.js covers typed groups/roundtrips, double negation, immutable edits, reorder/remove, validation and scoped choices; server/search.test.js covers rankings, event updates/deletes, comments, labels, pagination, parse errors, scopes and guest filtering; server/filters.test.js covers privacy, sharing, revocation, revision/duplicate validation, options and events; web/search.test.js covers route/query/action state; cli/search.test.js runs actual token-authenticated executable commands against a temporary HTTP server. scripts/checks/insight-search.mjs supplies smoke/restart/remount/audit to the insight aggregator. An additional pinned Chromium test uses an authenticated fixture to interact with keyboard completion, compound results, safe highlight rendering, the saved-filter form, typed-builder submission, stale-revision inspection/load, access-loss draft custody and live pause. filter-draft.test.js proves shared comparison identity, field choices, dirty decisions, exact payload validation and request admission/abandonment. filter-resource.test.js proves canonical current-query execution, opaque pages, second races, insight-only team-viewer personal copies, duplicate denial and source preservation through actual HTTP. filter-browser.test.js runs three actual pinned Chromium scenarios: list/direct resource/run/current query/paging/edit/copy; out-of-order reads, double submit and held create/delete responses across organization changes; per-field conflict decisions, second race, held inspection replacement and inaccessible draft retention. Its controlled fetch hook installs before app bootstrap and delays actual response bytes. The existing strengthened search-browser proof remains unchanged. search-persistence.test.js stops and restarts the actual server entrypoint with the same temporary database and token, then reads comment-index matches and the saved query without reseeding. The lead owns full acceptance login/board/inbox/browser and fresh-Workspace remount receipts.

import json, signal, sys
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.common.action_chains import ActionChains
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait, Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
s = json.loads(sys.argv[1]); driver = None
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, lambda *args: (_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError('Filter browser exceeded 25 seconds'))); signal.alarm(25)
try:
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions(); options.binary_location = '/usr/bin/chromium'
    options.set_capability('goog:loggingPrefs', {'browser': 'ALL'})
    for flag in ['--headless=new', '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--window-size=1440,1200']: options.add_argument(flag)
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=options); driver.set_page_load_timeout(8); wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 6)
    driver.get(s['url']); name, value = s['cookie'].split('=', 1); driver.add_cookie({'name': name, 'value': value, 'path': '/'})
    # Installed before app bootstrap: createApi captures this fetch function. Holds retain actual HTTP response bytes.
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd('Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument', {'source': """
      window.__nativeFetch = fetch.bind(window); window.__requests = []; window.__held = [];
      window.fetch = (url, options = {}) => {
        const path = new URL(url, location.href).pathname, method = options.method || 'GET';
        const entry = {url: String(url), path, method, body: options.body, hasSignal: Boolean(options.signal)};
        window.__requests.push(entry);
        const hold = window.__hold && window.__hold.path === path && window.__hold.method === method;
        if (hold) window.__hold = null;
        return window.__nativeFetch(url, options).then(async response => {
          entry.status = response.status;
          if (!hold) return response;
          const bytes = await response.arrayBuffer();
          return new Promise(resolve => window.__held.push({path, method, release: () => resolve(new Response(bytes, {status: response.status, headers: response.headers}))}));
        });
      };
    """})
    def visit(path):
        driver.execute_script('location.hash=arguments[0]', path)
    def button(text, parent=None):
        xpath = './/button[normalize-space()="' + text + '"]' if parent else '//main//button[normalize-space()="' + text + '"]'
        return wait.until(lambda d: (parent or d).find_element(By.XPATH, xpath) if (parent or d).find_element(By.XPATH, xpath).is_enabled() else False)
    def text(): return driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
    def write(selector, value):
        field = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, selector))); field.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL, Keys.BACKSPACE); field.send_keys(value); return field
    def form_name(): return driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value')
    def api(method, path, body=None):
        return driver.execute_async_script("const [method,path,body,done]=arguments;window.__nativeFetch('/api/v1'+path,{method,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','X-Crew-Request':'1'},body:body==null?undefined:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(async r=>done({status:r.status,data:await r.json()})).catch(e=>done({error:e.message}))", method, path, body)
    def card(name): return wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//ul[@class="saved-filters"]/li[.//h2/a[normalize-space()="' + name + '"]]')))
    def hold(method, filter_id, suffix=''):
        driver.execute_script('window.__hold={method:arguments[0],path:arguments[1]};window.__held=[]', method, '/api/v1/filters' + ('/' + filter_id if filter_id else '') + suffix)
    def held(): wait.until(lambda d: d.execute_script('return window.__held.length') == 1)
    def release(): driver.execute_async_script('const done=arguments[0];window.__held.splice(0).forEach(item=>item.release());requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(done))')
    def select_org(org):
        picker = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//fieldset[legend[normalize-space()="Organization"]]')
        Select(picker.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')).select_by_value(org)
    source_id = s['source']['id']; other_id = s['other']['id']; source_path = '/filters/' + source_id
    driver.get(s['url'] + '/?filter-proof=' + s['mode'] + '#/filters?orgId=' + s['orgId'])
    card('Source filter')
    if s['mode'] == 'resource':
        # The list still carries revision 1/query priority>=4; actual Run must read revision 2/query Resource.
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'query': 'Resource', 'expectedRevision': 1})['status'] == 200
        card('Source filter').find_element(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Run filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: '30 issues found' in text())
        assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[aria-label="Saved query"]').text == 'Resource'
        assert 'saved revision 2' in text() and len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results li')) == 25
        section = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'section[aria-label="Search results"]')
        button('Next', section).click(); wait.until(lambda d: 'Page 2' in section.text)
        assert len(section.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results li')) == 5
        requests = driver.execute_script('return window.__requests.filter(item=>item.path.endsWith("/search"))')
        assert len(requests) == 2 and all(item['path'] == '/api/v1' + source_path + '/search' for item in requests)
        assert parse_qs(urlparse(requests[1]['url']).query).get('cursor') and all(item['hasSignal'] for item in requests)
        assert not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results script') and not driver.execute_script('return Boolean(window.filterInjected)')
        button('Previous', section).click(); wait.until(lambda d: 'Page 1' in section.text)
        # A full direct link loads the canonical resource without a preceding list.
        driver.get(s['url'] + '/?direct-filter=1#' + source_path)
        button('Create personal copy').click(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == 'Source filter copy')
        write('.filter-form input', 'Deliberate personal copy')
        Select(driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form select')).select_by_value('personal')
        button('Save filter').click(); wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'h1').text == 'Deliberate personal copy')
        copied_id = driver.current_url.split('#/filters/')[1]
        copied = api('GET', '/filters/' + copied_id)['data']['filter']; original = api('GET', source_path)['data']['filter']
        assert copied['id'] != source_id and copied['visibility'] == 'personal' and copied['query'] == 'Resource'
        assert original['name'] == 'Source filter' and original['revision'] == 2
        button('Edit saved filter').click(); write('[aria-label="Saved filter query"]', 'priority>=4'); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: 'Saved “Deliberate personal copy”.' in text())
        assert api('GET', '/filters/' + copied_id)['data']['filter']['revision'] == 2
        button('Create personal copy').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Deliberate personal copy'); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: 'Choose a distinct name' in text()); assert form_name() == 'Deliberate personal copy'
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'currentQuery': True, 'directLink': True, 'opaquePages': requests, 'copy': copied['id'], 'sourceRevision': original['revision'], 'duplicateName': True, 'safeHighlights': True}))
    elif s['mode'] == 'custody':
        # Two out-of-order record reads: only the selected second record may own the editor.
        hold('GET', source_id); button('Edit', card('Source filter')).click(); held()
        button('Edit', card('Other filter')).click(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == 'Other filter'); release(); assert form_name() == 'Other filter'
        write('.filter-form input', 'Declined replacement'); button('Create saved filter').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss(); assert form_name() == 'Declined replacement'
        button('Create saved filter').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == '')
        write('.filter-form input', 'Published held create'); hold('POST', '')
        ActionChains(driver).double_click(button('Save filter')).perform(); held()
        posts = driver.execute_script('return window.__requests.filter(item=>item.method==="POST"&&item.path==="/api/v1/filters")')
        assert len(posts) == 1 and posts[0]['hasSignal'] and posts[0]['status'] == 201
        select_org(s['otherOrgId']); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss(); assert form_name() == 'Published held create'
        select_org(s['otherOrgId']); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); card('Second organization filter')
        button('Create saved filter').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Replacement org editor'); release()
        assert form_name() == 'Replacement org editor' and 'Saved “Published held create”.' not in text()
        assert len(api('GET', '/filters?orgId=' + s['orgId'] + '&q=Published')['data']['items']) == 1
        button('Cancel').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept()
        select_org(s['orgId']); card('Source filter')
        hold('DELETE', source_id); button('Delete', card('Source filter')).click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); held()
        select_org(s['otherOrgId']); card('Second organization filter'); release()
        assert 'Deleted “Source filter”.' not in text() and not driver.find_elements(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Source filter')
        assert api('GET', source_path)['status'] == 404
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'outOfOrderReads': True, 'doubleSubmitCount': len(posts), 'publishedAbandonedCreate': True, 'changedOrg': True, 'abandonedDelete': True, 'dirtyDeclineAndConfirm': True}))
    else:
        button('Edit', card('Source filter')).click(); write('.filter-form input', 'My name'); write('.filter-form textarea', 'My description')
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'name': 'Peer name', 'description': 'Peer description', 'query': 'priority>=3', 'expectedRevision': 1})['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); button('Inspect latest saved version').click()
        wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'aside[aria-label="Latest saved filter"]')))
        aside = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'aside[aria-label="Latest saved filter"]')
        assert 'Source filter' in aside.text and 'My name' in aside.text and 'Peer name' in aside.text
        apply = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Apply selected field choices"]'); assert not apply.is_enabled()
        driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//label[normalize-space()="Use mine for Name"]/input').click(); assert not apply.is_enabled()
        driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//label[normalize-space()="Use latest for Description"]/input').click(); button('Apply selected field choices').click()
        assert form_name() == 'My name' and driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form textarea').get_attribute('value') == 'Peer description'
        assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[aria-label="Saved filter query"]').get_attribute('value') == 'priority>=3'
        assert api('GET', source_path)['data']['filter']['name'] == 'Peer name'
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'query': 'priority>=2', 'expectedRevision': 2})['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); button('Inspect latest saved version').click(); button('Keep my changes on latest version').click(); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: 'Saved “My name”.' in text())
        saved = api('GET', source_path)['data']['filter']; assert saved['revision'] == 4 and saved['name'] == 'My name' and saved['query'] == 'priority>=2' and saved['description'] == 'Peer description'
        button('Edit', card('My name')).click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Retained before replacement')
        button('Cancel').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss(); assert form_name() == 'Retained before replacement'
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'name': 'Fifth revision', 'expectedRevision': 4})['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); hold('GET', source_id); button('Inspect latest saved version').click(); held()
        button('Edit', card('Other filter')).click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == 'Other filter'); release()
        assert form_name() == 'Other filter' and not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'aside[aria-label="Latest saved filter"]')
        write('.filter-form input', 'Retained inaccessible draft'); assert api('DELETE', '/filters/' + other_id)['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); wait.until(lambda d: 'no longer editable with your current access' in text())
        assert form_name() == 'Retained inaccessible draft' and not driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').is_enabled()
        assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').is_enabled()
        wait.until(lambda d: not d.find_elements(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Other filter'))
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'perFieldChoices': True, 'independentMerge': True, 'separateSave': True, 'secondRace': True, 'lateInspectSuppressed': True, 'accessLossCustody': True}))
except Exception:
    if driver:
        print(json.dumps({'body': driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text, 'url': driver.current_url, 'requests': driver.execute_script('return window.__requests'), 'logs': driver.get_log('browser')}), file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver: driver.quit()
